scope: Project Baltic keyboard selection and pending-composition extension; existing unopted layouts retain their behavior.
mode_selection: Selecting US or national mode, including reselection of the current mode, cancels a pending accent for an opted-in layout.
successful_reload: A successful reload cancels pending composition when the old or new layout opts in. The newly selected layout is activated again after the shared data is copied, so entering Baltic from a legacy layout also starts fresh.
failed_reload: A rejected selection does not activate a new layout and must preserve the old layout and its pending composition. Missing files, absent IDs and insufficient resident capacity are qualified here; additional failure paths remain to be checked.
legacy: German CP437 acute composition is retained across German self-reload and rejected selections, because that layout does not opt in.
allocation: The initial resident allocation limit is preserved in every successful table rebuild. It must not be replaced by the temporary FFFF initializer or narrowed when a smaller library is loaded.
public_interface: Uses the existing INT 2Fh AX=AD82h activation request; adds no interrupt function number.
initial_allocation: Start KEYB from KEYBRD2.SYS when Baltic switching is required. Loading the original, smaller KEYBOARD.SYS first does not provide capacity to grow into the Baltic tables; that load is rejected.
